cta_rules: destination and expected commitment are explicit
hook_rules: subject reflects a real trigger or job
email.platform_job: Move one permissioned reader from a known lifecycle state to one useful next state.
email.primary_measurement: qualified reply, evidence click, activation and unsubscribe or complaint
email.timing_experiment: send-time holdout within the owner-approved lifecycle window

cta_rules: save, share, compare, or inspect according to asset job
hook_rules: cover or first frame states the value
instagram.platform_job: Build visual recognition and save-or-share utility around one identity-relevant use moment.
instagram.primary_measurement: non-follower reach, saves, shares and qualified profile action
proof_rules: disclose generated or sponsored context when required
instagram.timing_experiment: account-insight two-slot holdout in the owner timezone

accessibility_rules: carousel has reading order and alt text
cta_rules: prefer inspect, compare, reply, or run over generic learn-more
hook_rules: open with a work contradiction or observed decision cost
linkedin.platform_job: Earn professional attention and a decision-grade conversation from one named buying role.
linkedin.primary_measurement: qualified dwell, saves, expert replies and qualified conversation
proof_rules: state whether the result is observed or hypothetical
linkedin.timing_experiment: audience-activity two-slot holdout in the owner timezone

accessibility_rules: media has transcript or alt text
hook_rules: start with the unresolved local problem
reddit.platform_job: Contribute standalone utility inside a specific community before asking for attention.
reddit.primary_measurement: substantive replies, moderator acceptance and voluntary relay
reddit.timing_experiment: community-observed window; moderator norms override schedule

cta_rules: offer the next logical decision aid
do not interrupt the answer before value
seo_geo.platform_job: Resolve a search or answer-engine decision with original, citable information gain.
seo_geo.primary_measurement: qualified search entry, cited answer inclusion, evidence engagement and downstream action
proof_rules: include original evidence, tool, data, framework, or decision utility
seo_geo.timing_experiment: query-cohort and refresh-window comparison; ranking alone is not causal evidence

hook_rules: first frame contains tension or payoff
product relationship is visible by second three
tiktok.platform_job: Make a problem, proof or transformation legible in the first beat and sustain watch intent.
tiktok.primary_measurement: first-seconds retention, completion, rewatch, share and qualified action
tiktok.timing_experiment: same-format two-slot holdout; no universal best time

cta_rules: ask for a counterexample, test, or exact next step
hook_rules: make the claim quotable but bounded
x.platform_job: Create a compact, falsifiable point of view that earns qualified relay and reply.
x.primary_measurement: qualified replies, bookmarks, quoted relays and qualified click
proof_rules: attach the decisive datum or source
threads add evidence rather than restating
x.timing_experiment: same-topic two-slot holdout; event timing may be a declared covariate

cta_rules: choose one next video, tool, or decision step
youtube.platform_job: Fulfil a precise title-thumbnail promise and compound trust through useful watch time.
youtube.primary_measurement: appeal, retention, watch time, satisfaction and returning viewers
youtube.timing_experiment: audience analytics two-slot holdout by format

truth_boundary: These are platform-native production contracts, not assurances of algorithmic reach, virality, conversion, ranking or answer-engine inclusion.
